To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
BMP2 and RA induce NT3 responsiveness in developing sympathetic neurons.

bone morphogenetic proteins induce the expression of the neurotrophin receptor, TrkC, in developing sympathetic neurons, which in turn enhances the responsiveness to NT3, a neurotrophin that has been shown to be expressed in the target tissues of sympathetic neurons.
BMP2/RA induce neurotrophins responsiveness in developing SCG neurons by inducing the expression of trks and neurotrophins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanisms that underlie the acquisition of neurotrophins sensitivity in developing neurons.
the mechanisms by which the neuronal responsiveness to neurotrophic factors is regulated by extracellular signals during the developmental stage.
the mechanism of neurotrophins' responsiveness of developing sympathetic neuron and the role of BMP2 and RA in this process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BMP2/RA induce the expression of NT3 and the TrkC receptor, thereby making the SCG neurons responsive to NT3.
the BMP2/RA signaling pathway induces neurotrophin sensitivity in developing sympathetic neurons by sequential induction of trk and neurothrombin expressions.
the BMP2/RA signaling system is involved in the regulation of the neurotrophin sensitivity of the developing sympathetic neurons by controlling the expression of trks and their cognate ligands.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of the NT3 responsiveness is induced in the sympathetic neurons by BMP2/RA, which may be mediated by the endogenous NT3.
the expression of the TrkC receptor is regulated by BMP2 and RA in the developing rat sympathetic neurons, and that BMP2/RA can induce the endogenous production of NT3.
BMP2/RA can induce neurotrophins and the corresponding receptors, thereby regulating the neurotrophin dependence of neurons during their development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
BMP-2 can induce the expression of trkB mRNA in SCG neurons, which are normally responsive to NGF and BDNF.

BMP2 and RA are able to induce the expression of trkB and trkC receptors and neurotrophins, which are required for the responsiveness of sympathetic neurons to NT3, and to down-regulate NGF responsiveness of the SCG sympathetic neurons.
BMP2 and RA can regulate the expression of Trks and neurotrophins, which determine the responsiveness to different neurotrophins.
